Hi Liz — thanks for the clear list. Details below so your AP team can align: 

1) Standard net terms
- New suppliers are provisioned on Net45 by default while we complete validation. After the first two cleared invoices we typically transition to the agreed net term (Net30/Net60) based on the contract.

2) PO policy
- POs are required for any order > $5k and when a PO is outstanding we match invoice -> PO lines. For recurring subscription services (like Redwood hosted plans) a single master PO is acceptable and we route invoices to the subscription PO.

3) Invoice requirements (please use the attached template)
- Required fields: Redwood PO#, invoice number, invoice date, due date, line item descriptions, tax breakdown, remittance instructions.
- File format: .xlsx or PDF preferred. Electronic invoices (email + portal upload) speed processing.

4) Early-pay / accelerated remittance options
- We offer an Accelerated Remittance program: suppliers can opt in to receive payment earlier than net terms for a small discount. Typical pilot: Net30 + 1.5% early-pay discount to move payment to Net7 once enrolled. Enrollment requires bank ACH details and a short addendum.
- For long-term partners we can negotiate lower discount rates depending on volume.

5) One-time expedite for first invoice
- For onboarding exceptions, Finance can approve a one-time expedited payment if we receive: (a) fully completed supplier setup form, (b) e-invoice using our template, and (c) a valid PO (if required). If those arrive by 2028-08-25 we can target payment the week of 2028-09-01. This is a one-off operational expedite, not a change to standard credit policy.

Next steps / links
- Vendor portal: https://vendor.redwood.inference.com/register?ref=archer
- DocuSign for ACH/W-9: https://docusign.com/US/Sign?token=0a1b2c3d4e
- Attachment: Invoice_Template.xlsx (please populate and upload)
- Attachment: Payment_SLA_Addendum.pdf (contains accelerated remittance enrollment steps)

If you confirm you'd like to pilot Net30 with the Accelerated Remittance option we can flag your vendor record and expedite the setup. Karthik — please advise on the PO gating for subscription POs.

Best,
Marissa Cole
